title: Out of bounds read in FileSystem in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to read memory…
description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the FileSystem component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw allows a remote attacker to read memory inside the sandbox by delivering a specially crafted HTML page. The Chromium project has assigned this issue a medium security severity rating.
